explain.say: Your home has everything you need: food, water and a safe place to sleep. Animals have homes too, called habitats. A habitat is the place where an animal lives and finds what it needs. Let's sort these animals into their homes.

faq.a: A habitat is the natural home of an animal or plant, where it finds food, water, shelter and a place to raise its young. Oceans, deserts, the Arctic and rainforests are habitats.

faq.q: Which animals live in the ocean?
faq.a: Fish, sharks, whales, dolphins, octopuses, sea turtles, crabs and jellyfish are some of the many animals that live in the ocean.

faq.q: Which animals live in the desert?
faq.a: Camels, fennec foxes, scorpions, many lizards and snakes, and desert beetles live in deserts. Many hide from the heat in the day and come out at night.

faq.q: Why can a polar bear not live in a rainforest?
faq.a: A polar bear has thick fur and a layer of fat to stay warm on the ice, and it hunts seals. In a hot rainforest it would overheat and find no seals to eat.
asks: Can animals live in any habitat?

faq.a: An adaptation is a body part or habit that helps an animal live in its habitat, like a camel's wide feet for sand or a polar bear's thick fur for cold.
asks: How are animals suited to their homes?

facts: Tropical rainforests are home to roughly half of the world's land plant and animal species.
The thorny devil lizard of Australia can draw water to its mouth through tiny grooves between its scales.

quiz.say: A fennec fox has giant ears and lives where it is hot and dry. What is its habitat?
quiz.show: The fennec fox lives in the…
quiz.why: The fennec fox lives in the Sahara desert; its big ears help it lose heat.

wrong.0: The Arctic is icy; big ears would lose too much heat there.
wrong.2: Foxes cannot live in the ocean.

quiz.say: Why does a polar bear have thick fur?
quiz.show: A polar bear has thick fur to…
quiz.why: Thick fur and fat keep the polar bear warm in its icy Arctic habitat.

wrong.1: Thick fur actually makes swimming harder, not faster.
wrong.2: Its fur is for warmth, not for looking big.
